lookupTypes.title: Product types
lookupTypes.description: Vertical / catalogue family (e.g. saree, grocery). Product rows store the value id as product_type_id; vendor Product tab binds to this lookup.

lookupTypes.title: Product categories
lookupTypes.description: Merchandising categories for the storefront. Use Code as the URL slug (e.g. kanjivaram) and Label as the shopper-facing name. Browse uses /browse/:categorySlug — keep Code unique and slug-safe.
